seoTitle: Ohm's Law Calculator: Volts, Amps, Ohms and Watts
metaDescription: Enter any two of voltage, current, resistance and power and get the other two. Accepts k, M and m suffixes. Free.
intro: Solves Ohm's law and the power formulas from any two known values among V, I, R and P.
why:
Pick any two values of the four and the rest follow from V = I x R and P = V x I. It is handy for choosing a resistor or checking an LED circuit.

Results use engineering prefixes. It treats the circuit as an ideal resistor, so it does not model reactance or heating.
howTo: Use suffixes like 4.7k or 20m if useful.

faq.a: Two values fix the rest. One is too few, three could conflict.
For RMS values with a purely resistive load, yes.
